fields.summary_ko.0: 24/7 Wall St.'s AMZN price target is $324.74, presenting 24.8% upside from the current price of $260.21, with AWS 39% growth as the key catalyst.
fields.summary_ko.1: AMZN Q3 revenue increased 12.1% to $201.94B, and operating income surged 61.2% to $28.08B, achieving record 13.9% operating margin.
fields.summary_ko.2: AWS backlog of $578B is expected to grow 40% or more in 2027 and 2028, but concerns persist over Q3 capital expenditure increase of 120% to $77.26B and favorable free cash flow.
